post.description:
Owner login

Returns JWT tokens for authenticated owner.
If the owner has a temporary password, returns a restricted token
that only works with set-password.

get.description:
Get current owner profile

Requires authentication via JWT token.

post.description:
Reset owner password (authenticated owner who knows their current password).

Requires old password for verification.

Request a password reset email for owner.

Always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration.

Set new owner password using a temporary token.

Works for both flows:
- First login: token from login response (purpose=set_password)
- Forgot password: token from reset email (purpose=owner_password_reset)

Returns full access/refresh credentials on success.

get.description:
List all companies owned by the current owner

Returns a list of all companies with basic information.

schema.title: Response List Companies Api V1 Owner Companies Get

post.description:
Create a new company

Only owners can create companies. The owner selects the telephony provider
(Sipuni or Binotel) and provides the provider configuration.

The provider cannot be changed after company creation.

Invite a superadmin to a company (Owner only)

Creates a COMPANY_ADMIN user with full admin permissions
and sends an email invitation with a temporary password.

get.description:
Get detailed information about a specific company

Includes provider configuration and settings.

put.description:
Update company information

Can update name, settings, and active status.
Provider type and configuration cannot be changed.

delete.description:
Delete a company

By default performs soft delete (can be restored).
Use hard=true for permanent deletion.

post.description:
Create a contract for a company.

Validates company ownership and ensures no duplicate active contracts.

get.description: List all contracts owned by the current owner, with optional filters.

schema.title: Response List Contracts Api V1 Owner Contracts Get

get.description: Get detailed contract information with current usage counts.

put.description: Update contract limits, pricing, or payment status.

post.description: Renew a contract: reset status to ACTIVE and extend end_date.

get.description:
Get platform-wide analytics (Owner only)

OPTIMIZED:
- Single query for company/user counts
- Aggregated stats across all companies (not N queries)
- Top companies ranked in single query

Get owner dashboard (Owner only)

OPTIMIZED:
- Caching with 5 minute TTL
- Aggregated queries across all companies
- Single queries for trends

delete.description:
Clear owner analytics cache

Use this after bulk data imports or when you need fresh data.

get.description:
List all available permissions and default permissions per role

Returns every permission constant and the default set for each company role.
